enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Pick up clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a slow breakfast of toast and tea using the toaster and kettle, then rinsing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Take out plate. Place bread on plate. Open fridge. Take out butter. Take out jam. Take out knife. Spread butter on bread. Spread jam on bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Wait. Take out tea bag. Place in mug. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Wait for boil. Pour water into mug. Add milk. Stir. Take toast from toaster. Put on plate. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish. Stand up. Take plate and mug to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Rinse mug. Turn off tap. Place in drying rack. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running a load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Sort clothes. Put clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Turn dial to select cycle. Press start button. Washing machine starts. Wait. Check machine. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the bedroom and making the bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up clothes from floor. Put in hamper. Pick up books. Put on shelf. Straighten desk items. Pull bed sheets. Smooth blanket. Fluff pillows. Place pillows. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying at the desk on the computer: reading set texts and drafting a Master of Education assignment with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open document. Open textbook. Read page. Take notes. Type on keyboard. Highlight text. Turn page. Read more. Type more. Save document. Check email. Open reference. Copy citation. Paste into document. Format text. Continue typing.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off cooker. Transfer to plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch and cleaning up the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat lunch. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Take plate to sink. Scrape food. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local shops for grocery shopping and a bit of fresh air on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open door. Walk outside. Walk along street. Enter shop. Pick up basket. Walk aisles. Select items. Put in basket. Go to checkout. Pay. Put items in bag. Walk back home. Open door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and putting items into the refrigerator and freezer
enriched_activities.desc: Place bags on counter. Open fridge. Take items out. Place in fridge. Open freezer. Place items. Close doors. Fold bags. Put bags away.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing study on the computer: watching recorded lecture material and taking notes
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open lecture video. Play. Watch. Pause. Take notes. Play. Watch. Type. Pause. Rewind. Play. Take notes. Save notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch. Adjust fan speed. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner ingredients and cooking on the induction cooker with the range hood on
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on range hood. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Wash. Chop. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off cooker.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and washing up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish. Stand up. Take dishes to sink. Turn on tap. Wash dishes. Rinse. Turn off tap. Dry dishes. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on assignment writing and referencing at the desk on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open document. Type. Search references. Copy citation. Paste. Format. Type more. Save. Check word count. Continue typing.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time watching TV and playing a game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up controller. Turn on console. Start game. Play. Pause. Watch TV. Resume game. Play. Turn off console. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with light reading and checking the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Read page. Turn page. Read. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock. Scroll. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off desk lamp.
Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to side. Sleep. Remain asleep.
